Check a certificate

Paste the certificate JSON. Anyone can check its serial against the public revocation list; full signature validation runs with your API key — or offline, against the CA’s published keys, without trusting our server at all.

Don’t trust our AI — verify our proof. A certificate is only as good as its checkability. This page, the API, and the published revocation list are how you hold us accountable.
